description: PRIMARY TRIAL TOOL. USE WHEN you need actual clinical-trial RECORDS for a disease, intervention, sponsor, country or date window. Searches DISTINCT real-world trials across the admitted PRIMARY registries — ClinicalTrials.gov (US NIH) and ISRCTN (UK) — deduplicated by exact cross-registry identifier match, so a trial registered twice is returned ONCE, not twice. Secondary aggregators are deliberately excluded, so the index is registry-authoritative but NOT a census of every country. Every result is evidence-ready: canonical id, normalized status/phase/study type/enrollment/countries/primary endpoints, the registries that hold it, source URLs, retrieval timestamps, payload checksums and a quotable `citation` block. HOW TO NARROW: use q for the disease, then intervention to separate MODALITIES within that disease (e.g. "stem cell", "encapsulation", "gene edit", "xenotransplant") — running several intervention-scoped searches is how you build a comparative landscape. Use status="active" for currently-running human studies. SCOPE WARNING: omit `registry` to keep the answer worldwide; supplying it makes the result single-registry evidence and you must label it as such. ROWS ARE COMPACT by default (20 per page, about 10 KB); pass include="full" only when you need endpoints, eligibility or locations, or call get_world_trial for one trial. COUNTING: read data.totalCanonical or call get_trial_coverage; do NOT page through results to count. Page with _meta.pagination.nextUrl only when you need more records to read. Status/phase/studyType/country are case-insensitive and normalized (US = USA = United States; 1 = I = PHASE1); unknown values return 400. q expands lay terms and MeSH/ICD-10 codes (juvenile diabetes, E10, heart attack); data.resolvedTerms shows what was searched. NEXT: get_world_trial for one trial's full per-registry provenance and raw payload; get_trial_coverage to learn how much of your result set is duplicate registrations; get_trial_landscape for the derived shape (phase mix, sponsors, reporting gap, momentum); find_trial_registrations to see every registry one trial appears in.

condition.description: Exact registry condition term. Prefer q unless you know the exact string.

country.description: Recruiting/site country: full English name or ISO code (US, USA, UK, DE, ...).

crossRegistry.description: true = only trials registered in more than one registry.

include.description: "full" for complete records instead of compact rows; "eligibilityText" adds the full inclusion/exclusion prose (large). Use only when you must reason about endpoints or eligibility.

intervention.description: Free-text intervention match: the way to separate MODALITIES within one disease.

pageSize.description: Results per page (default 20, max 100). Keep it small: use get_trial_coverage for counts.

phase.description: Comma-separated phases: 1-4, I-IV, early_phase1, or 1/2. Phase is missing for much of the corpus.

q.description: Free-text condition/intervention query, e.g. "type 1 diabetes islet". Tokens are ANDed.

registry.description: clinicaltrials_gov | isrctn. OMIT for full-index scope, restricting to one registry makes the answer single-registry evidence.

resultsAvailable.description: Restrict to trials with/without posted results.

status.description: recruiting | active_not_recruiting | not_yet_recruiting | completed | halted | terminated | withdrawn | not_authorised | unknown, or "active" for any open status (recruiting + active_not_recruiting + not_yet_recruiting). Case-insensitive; unknown values return 400.

topic.description: Cure Protocol topic id (get_trial_stats lists them).

updatedSince.description: ISO date: only records updated on/after this date.

name: search_world_trials
